_comment: The point of the `unchanged` action: a stored UNVERIFIED event already holding exactly what this run would send must plan `unchanged`, not `update`, so apply_plan issues no HTTP. The stored `description`/`end` are byte-for-byte what `build_event_body` + `description_for` produced on the run that wrote it. Asserted by tests/test_calendar_idempotency.py.
